justifications.type_expressiveness: Good use of enums for Expr, Value, BinOp, and EvalError variants, though TypeError carries a String payload rather than a structured variant distinguishing operator/operand kinds.
justifications.error_handling: Typed EvalError with the three required variants, ParseError carries offset, no panics in normal paths, but a couple of unreachable!() and from_utf8().unwrap() calls lack documented justification.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Clean public surface with sensible derives (Debug/Clone/PartialEq) and Display impls, but there are no doc comments on any public items.
justifications.idiomaticity: Reads like reasonable Rust with ?, matches!, let-else, and iterators, though the env-as-Vec lookup, repeated cloning of identifier strings, and re-matching after peek (instead of consuming the token directly) are slightly awkward.
